answer: A stranger came to the forge asking for a chain, and the smith asked him for the iron he had carried. Proof of dyer vat via indigo dip count is the asking: a vat the dyer dips only after 7 dips turn the cloth, each dip timed by the vat master's own hourglass. The trellis is the iron, carried on his own back; the raven is the fire, lit by his own hand; the echo is the chain the forge still holds no trace of. A cheat must carry 47 false bars and light 47 false fires in one morning.
